name: application-split-button
title: Split Button
description: A primary action button fused with a caret that opens a menu of related secondary actions.
useWhen: One action is clearly the default (Deploy, Save) but users occasionally need closely related variants of it.
You want to keep the primary action a single click while still surfacing secondary options without extra buttons cluttering the toolbar.
avoidWhen: All the actions are equally likely to be used — a plain button group communicates that better than implying one is primary.
There is no true default action — use a standalone dropdown menu instead of implying one option is primary.
responsiveBehavior: The component is a fixed-width inline-flex cluster; the menu is absolutely positioned and right-aligned so it stays within the viewport when the button sits near the right edge.
accessibility: The caret toggle carries aria-haspopup="menu" and aria-expanded, kept in sync with the menu's visibility.
The caret has an aria-label describing what it opens, since it is icon-only.
The menu uses role="menu" with role="menuitem" on each action, and closes on an outside click.
focus:relative and focus:z-10 on each segment keep the focus ring from being clipped by the adjacent button's shared border.

variants.title: Primary
variants.description: Filled primary split button with a Deploy default action and related deployment options in the menu
accessibility: The caret's aria-expanded state is toggled on click and reset when the menu closes via outside click.
